claims.assertion: Swaruu X says Federation tiers have different jurisdictions and density-linked ethics.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: She describes Earth as a contained learning realm guided in detail by the Federation; total nuclear war is barred, though localized wars may occur.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says this control is framed as preserving inhabitants’ rights.

claims.assertion: Swaruu X says the Federation views humanity as a shared Lyrian-patterned biological suit for multiple species, not a species; it will not permit humans to expand as such.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says the Federation regards humanity as already interstellar.

proposed_topics.name: Humanity as a shared biological suit
